requirements.gap: Direct organization seals and the separately selected current X509/CMS delegation application exercise scoped authority, an attenuating path, raw independent approvals and durable execution/recovery. The retained-evidence verifier adds complete-package ERS preservation, explicit proof-time and current-knowledge views, scoped successor status and cumulative authenticated negative knowledge. Its dedicated SQLite source reauthenticates retained raw material across process restarts and returns a receipt only for the documented storage outcome; retained bytes and historical results grant no current execution permission. Whole-database rollback cannot be detected without an external anchor. Selected credential CertificateStatus may carry its own RFC 4998 proof over the complete CMS. Its status authority is admitted at publication S and first status proof P_status under knowledge K, with S <= P_status <= K and continuous protection through K. This does not replace original-package status or authority evidence, current positive-acceptance coverage, or retained negative knowledge. Organizational mdoc, arbitrary graphs, per-object proofs for original-package roles retired before the first complete-package proof, separately preserved organization/delegation status from retired signers, independently assessed identity/custody and a second complete implementation remain open.
